title: GroomLab graph
description: A groom's node graph as .groom files, presets and the hosts store it (version 1). Params a node leaves out take its operator's defaults; groomlab-cli --list-operators and the MCP server's describe_node give each type's params. See https://getgroomlab.com/docs/groom-format.

version.description: The operator behaviour the node keeps.

params.description: Param values: numbers, booleans, strings, [x, y, z], ramps as [[position, value], ...], maps as objects.

paramControls.description: Params keyed to the host's controls, by param name.

ui.description: The node's position in the node editors (layout only).

output.description: The source's output by name; absent: its first.
The node whose result is the groom.
